Hymn 105: Master, the Tempest Is Raging
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: A-flat Major

This is hymn number 105 titled "Master, the Tempest Is Raging" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by H. R. Palmer and the lyrics were written by Mary Ann Baker.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
